name: top30-data
description: Data engineering skills and an agent from the top30ongithub kit. oracle-to-snowflake translates Oracle SQL with SQLGlot and flags silent differences; snowflake-cost-investigator finds where credits go from read-only ACCOUNT_USAGE views; snowflake-query-advisor turns a query or .sql file into an explain-style plan with rewrites that cut scanning, spill and credits; the pipeline-failure-triage agent finds the root cause of a failed Airflow/dbt/Snowflake run.
